usedFor: Whautomate holds your appointments, and Slack tells the team when “Send Message” follows “New Appointment Scheduled”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Appointment Scheduled” in Whautomate, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking posts to a Slack channel, so the team knows who is coming.

watchOut: A post to a Slack channel from an automation waits for your approval before it goes out.
